title: Graphic Designer Contractor - Gulf Binance
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. About the Role As part of BINANCE TH, a leading digital asset platform committed to advancing the adoption of blockchain and cryptocurrency in Thailand, we are seeking a highly creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer Freelance to support our growing marketing and content initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for producing compelling visual assets across digital channels, including both static and motion content. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate campaign concepts into engaging visuals that align with BINANCE TH’s brand identity and global standards. This position requires a strong balance of speed, creativity, and precision, with the ability to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining strict adherence to brand guidelines. This is a contract position for 6 months to 1 year. This advertisement is for a position at Gulf Binance.
